priceSnapshot.note: THE LID BROKE. This is the first session in three days that has something real to report. The 82,099.0 ceiling that rejected price twice on 19 and 20 September gave way in the 08:00 UTC hour and BTC ran to 85,325.2, its highest print since 29 January 2026 - an eight-month high. Spot is 84,742.7 against the midnight mark of 81,557.6, up 3,185.1 points or 3.90 percent in four hours and forty minutes, and up 5.28 percent against the 24-hour open of 80,493.2. The 24-hour range widened from a 1,925-point box to 80,332.3 to 85,325.2. Unlike the three files that published in a burst around midnight, this session had a genuine handover window to review - the previous snapshot is four hours and forty minutes old and the market used every minute of it. Every number below was recomputed from settled OKX candles read in-browser; nothing is carried from a sibling file.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close back BELOW the broken 82,099.0 lid. That is what turns this from a breakout into a failed break, and it is the level that would justify reducing the core rather than merely trimming it. A wick through is not enough - the 19 and 20 September rejections both printed wicks either side of that number before resolving.

addIf.confirmation: A pullback into the 82,099.0 to 82,600.0 flip zone that HOLDS on a settled 1H close, with the 1H EMA20 - currently 82,034.7 and rising fast - catching up into it. That is the redeployment level for the cash this session's trim raised. The alternative add is on strength: a settled 4H close above 85,631.3, the 29 January 2026 high, which is the only piece of overhead supply between here and the upper 88,000s.

decisionBox.changed: Everything changed. Midnight carried a HOLD-the-core stance with an ADD executed at 81,557.6 and named 82,099.0 as the twice-rejected lid to watch; that gate resolved UPWARD four hours later. The reduce gate moves up from 80,750.0 to 82,099.0, because the broken ceiling is now the only support that matters - 80,750.0 is 4,000 points away and no longer a live risk level. The add gate moves from 82,099.0 to a 82,099.0-82,600.0 retest zone, inverting it from a breakout trigger into a pullback buy. Position flips from ADD to TAKE_PROFIT: not because the bias soured, but because the wallet was right, is now extended, and has only 26.19 USDT of dry powder ahead of the single most likely near-term event, a retest of the level it just cleared.

liquidation.note: 322,615 USD of forced SHORT closing in the 84,625-84,875 band, 91 percent of all liquidation value in the 71-minute window. This is the squeeze itself - the fuel that carried price through 82,099.0 and up to 85,325.2. It is realized, not resting, so treat it as evidence of where the shorts were rather than as a magnet still pulling.
29,817 USD of short liquidations in the 84,375-84,625 band. The shelf the breakout paused on; the first place a pullback would find recent forced buyers.
1,511 USD only. The tape thins out immediately above 84,875 - there was very little short inventory left that high, which is one reason the 85,325.2 print did not extend.
101 USD. Essentially nothing. Below 84,000 there is no recent liquidation structure at all until the pre-breakout base at 81,459.7.

liquidityMagnet.note: The pull is UP and it is not close. Over the last 71 minutes OKX filled 350,560 USD of SHORT liquidations against 3,484 USD of longs - a ratio of 100 to 1. The long/short ACCOUNT ratio is 0.98 for the 11:00 UTC bucket, down from 1.04 at midnight, so retail positioning flipped from marginally long-crowded to marginally short-crowded right as price broke out, which is the textbook way a squeeze feeds itself. Open interest ROSE to 2,511,948,278 USD, up 0.84 percent from midnight's 2,491,054,777 - leverage is being added into the move rather than evicted by it. The honest caveat: these are REALIZED fills, so they map where the shorts were, not where resting stops sit now. The forward magnet above 85,325.2 is unmeasured by this feed.

The 85,325.2 spike was rejected, price gave back to 84,137.5, and the last five bars have rebuilt higher lows into 84,617.0 with a close of 84,829.5 - so the retracement held above the 84,000 shelf and did not retest the breakout base. Price is above all four EMAs and the stack is in perfect bullish order, 20 over 50 over 100 over 200, with the EMA200 at 81,461.7 sitting almost exactly on the pre-breakout base.

liquidations.note: A clean short squeeze, measured not inferred. Realized OKX fills over 2026-09-21T10:40:35Z to 11:51:58Z, 100 fills, newest 6 minutes old at read: 350,560 USD of SHORT liquidations against 3,484 USD of longs, a 100-to-1 tilt, with 322,615 USD of it concentrated in the single 84,750 band. Compare the midnight read - 189,432 short against 65,545 long, a 2.9-to-1 tilt - and the direction of travel is obvious: the short side has been progressively evicted for six hours and the eviction accelerated through the 82,099.0 break. The skew field is the OKX long/short ACCOUNT ratio at 0.98 for the 11:00 UTC bucket, against 0.95 and 0.96 in the two prior hours and 1.04 at midnight; retail flipped from marginally long-crowded to marginally short-crowded precisely into the breakout, which is the fuel for a continuation but also the reason the easy part is over. Open interest is 2,511,948,278 USD, UP 0.84 percent from midnight's 2,491,054,777 - new leverage entering on the long side while shorts are forced out, the constructive combination. Funding on BTC-USDT-SWAP is plus 0.0001, exactly one basis point and unchanged from midnight, with premium at minus 0.00046; longs pay the baseline and nothing more, so this is NOT yet a crowded, expensive long. Next settlement 16:00 UTC. Absolute scale remains small - 354,044 USD across 71 minutes on one venue - so read the ratios, not the dollars.

calibration.note: The midnight session is graded a clear WIN and the window was long enough to say so honestly - four hours and forty minutes, unlike the ten-minute non-windows the burst produced overnight. Midnight bought a 15 USDT spot tranche at 81,557.6 and named the exact thesis: short liquidations inverting to 189,432 against 65,545, the largest forced-buying bucket sitting ABOVE spot at 81,750, open interest rising 1.02 percent, and unbroken 1H higher lows off the 82,099.0 rejection. Every one of those readings pointed at the break that then happened. At 84,742.7 that tranche is worth 15.586 USDT, up 0.586 or 3.90 percent. The reduce gate at 80,750.0 was never threatened - the session low was 81,459.7, leaving 709.7 points of clearance - so priorReduceFired is false. The one fair criticism: midnight sized DOWN to 15 USDT from midday's 20 on the argument that the buy was in the upper third of a flag rather than at support. That caution cost roughly 0.20 USDT of upside. It was still the right process - the flag could equally have failed a third time at 82,099.0, and it had already failed there twice.
